name: Arcos de Jalón (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Arcos de Jalón (a bridge on brown within an inscribed bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Arcos de Jalón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arcos de Jalón arms — bridge on brown within an inscribed bordure
